closeCard.headline: Say it this way
closeCard.lede: The two pairs people mix up
points: Name it, name the scene, name the rule

lines.zh: 给侧栏起对名字。贴在左边只是外观。先定占不占位、变宽还是盖上来。
lines.en: Name the sidebar. Sitting on the left is only the skin. First decide occupancy, and whether expand grows or overlays.

lines.zh: 悬浮岛占位但不贴边，四周留白才是一张卡。
lines.en: A floating island occupies but is inset. Padding makes it a card.

lines.zh: 滚轮是一条有序选择器，到基准线才高亮，不是目录树。
lines.en: A wheel is an ordered selector. Only the baseline is current.

lines.zh: 多级是树：父级只归类，子级才是页。
lines.en: Multi-level is a tree. A parent only files; a child is the page.

lines.zh: 可折叠变宽，收起后仍占一条图标栏。
lines.en: Collapsible changes width. Collapsed still occupies an icon rail.

lines.zh: 隐藏式默认宽度为零，滑入盖住内容。
lines.en: Off-canvas has zero width until it slides in over the content.

lines.zh: 最容易混的两对：可折叠不是隐藏式，多级不是滚轮。先说名称、场景和规则，再谈外观。
lines.en: The two pairs people mix up: collapsible is not off-canvas; multi-level is not a wheel. Name it, name the scene, name the rule.
